description: Real technical/melodic minor-key djent, calibrated directly from a real 12-song reference corpus (Born of Osiris + Veil of Maya, mixed MIDI + Guitar Pro transcriptions) via engine/reference_vocab.py -- not a genre guess. Interval vocabulary is the real averaged per-song riff track measurement (root/5th/minor-3rd-dominant, real secondary color), not hand-tuned.
